name: confirm-dialog

native.scope: Native forbids the current external form association. An admitted submission adapter must preserve the original submitter, native validation, and signed transport.

ports.name: confirmed-submit
ports.purpose: The app handles confirmed intent using the original form, submitter, and cancellation signal. The component does not authorize, own an endpoint, or assert command success.

summary: Confirms a consequential existing form submission through a native dialog with an honest no-JavaScript submit trigger.

agent.useWhen: An existing form submits a costly, destructive, or difficult-to-reverse operation.
agent.avoidWhen: The action is safe or reversible, requires a new endpoint, or has no existing validated form.

contract.role: native confirmation dialog for an existing form submitter
invariants: Title and body are plain escaped text; configuration cannot provide markup.
The trigger is a real submit button with an explicit existing form association and remains a no-JavaScript fallback.
Enhancement requires the associated form, original submitter, native dialog API, and requestSubmit; otherwise native submit behavior is untouched.

Without a custom adapter, confirmation calls requestSubmit with the original submitter. A supplied app port receives that form/submitter and a cancellation signal; native constraint validation and signed transport remain app-owned.
Cancel, Escape, or backdrop close never submits. The app/server remains responsible for validation, authorization, and destructive effects.
Derived IDs include the dialog, title, and body; reserve all against page collisions.
The current Native host forbids external form= associations and has no confirm-dialog adapter seam. Native integration remains adapter-required; do not bypass host admission or add an endpoint.
